title: Federal Acquisition Regulation: Prohibition on Certain Semiconductor Products and Services (proposed rule, FR Doc 2026-03065)
supports: FAR Case 2023-008 proposed rule published 2026-02-17; comments due 2026-04-20; prohibitions effective 2027-12-23; adds FAR 52.240-XX certification provision and 52.240-YY clause; commercial services excepted except IT/telecom services; applies prospectively (no rip-and-replace) (via search snippet); [REPORTED-P]

title: FAR Council Proposes Rule to Ban Purchases of Certain Semiconductor Products and Services
supports: 5949 proposed rule is the second (penultimate) rulemaking step; effective 2027-12-23 'with some exceptions'; 'critical system' = national security systems (40 USC 11103(a)(1)) or systems identified by FASC/DoD; reasonable inquiry does not necessarily require third-party audits; lower-tier suppliers must inquire and certify (via search snippet)

title: Section 5949 Proposed Rule Puts the FAR Council's Chips on the Table
supports: 5949 proposed rule: waiver procedures (cabinet secretaries), safe harbor aligned with 5949(h), commercial-services exception except IT/telecom (via search snippet); a 72-hour reporting window vs statutory 60 days was reported by one analysis in this result set but the snippet did not identify which page

title: FAR Council Proposes Rule to Prohibit Acquisition of Semiconductors from China and Countries of Concern
supports: 5949 proposed rule adds FAR 40.20X, 52.240-XX (offeror certification after reasonable inquiry; government may seek exception/waiver for noncompliant offer) and flow-down clause 52.240-YY; two disclosure safe harbors (via search snippet)

title: FAR Council Proposes Rule Restricting Certain Semiconductor Products and Services
supports: 5949 covered entities = SMIC, CXMT, YMTC plus subsidiaries/affiliates/successors and future designees; prohibitions would apply to micro-purchases and COTS items; Part B limited to critical systems; proposed disclosure requirement re sales to non-federal customers (via search snippet)

title: (LexBlog post on Section 5949 proposed rule)
